maintenance_led.reason: Revenue mainly from presort mail services, shipping software, SendTech mailing equipment/supplies and financing; not mainly repair of installed base.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mostly private businesses of all sizes, plus some government agencies and universities; most revenue is private.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows through its own mailing, shipping and presort businesses; it has been restructuring and divesting, not rolling up companies.

mission_critical.reason: Embedded mailing systems, postage meters, presort networks and shipping software are costly to replace and compliance-linked, so switching causes disruption.

notes: Revenue split between recurring equipment/supplies/services and presort is uncertain; maintenance_led judged no on balance.
